correctness.rationale: For all m>=2 and a!=0, direct characteristic-two expansion produces affine map L_c(t)=t(t+1)(t^2+t+1+c). The exceptional c=1 is treated separately to avoid double counting quadratic roots; the trace-zero condition and exclusion of c=0 only for even m give exact n4. The map s↦a/s² bijects nonzero directions. Every finite-field affine linearized map has all nonempty fibers of size its kernel; origin row gives q. Multiplicity-weighted sums prove H0/H2/H4/Hq and energy/occupied counts. Verification independently enumerates complete target histograms for 140 parameter cases including 124 full coefficient tests; finite tests do not replace proof.

value.rationale: The exact DDT is an intrinsic, widely motivated cryptographic and additive-combinatorial invariant of Dickson quintics; it reveals a sharp APN-to-four-uniform boundary and exact four-fiber direction proportions, sumset sizes, and energies. These nontrivial, all-extension classifications neither follow from permutation alone nor merely rename the Gold monomial; the nonzero perturbation changes the derivative kernels and global energies. The result is natural for S-box graph collision analysis.
